problem: A $240\,\text{gal}$-capacity tank initially holds $150\,\text{gal}$ of a brine (salt-water) solution containing $32\,\text{lb}$ of salt. Fresh water begins to flow into the tank at a rate of $3\,\text{gal/min},$ while the completely mixed brine flows out at a rate of $2\,\text{gal/min}.$ Find the amount of salt in the tank at the moment it begins to overflow.
